title: MDR-TB cohort As part of the joint project: Establishment and evaluation of a competence network therapy adherence for the sustainable improvement of therapy results in multidrug-resistant tuberculosis in Germany
summary:
The main purpose of the MDR-TB cohort study is to find out which backgrounds and risks can lead to treatment discontinuation in patients with multidrug-resistant tuberculosis (MDR-TB). 

For patients participating in the study, certain demographic and health-related data will be collected on admission to and discharge from hospital and during the period of further treatment until a definite treatment outcome is reached. In particular, the course of the disease and therapy will be observed. No surveys or interventions are carried out for the study that go beyond the usual clinical routine.

The results of the study will be used directly to establish a network to support MDR-TB patients in successfully completing treatment.

interventions.name: Prospective study part: Observation of course of disease and therapy as well as therapy outcome in adult patients with multidrug-resistant or rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis (MDR/RR-TB) in one of the participating study sites

Retrospective study part: Recording of course of disease and therapy as well as therapy outcome in adult MDR/RR-TB patients who completed or failed therapy at one of the participating study centers before the start of the study period

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1) Written consent to participate in the study after language-based explanation of the study objectives and procedures
2) MDR/RR therapy in one of the participating study centers
Exclusion criteria:
1) Restrictions due to which, in the opinion of the study physicians, it is not possible to give informed consent to participate in the study
2) Restrictions due to which, in the opinion of the study physicians, it is not possible to understand and fulfill the study requirements.
3) Concurrent participation in an interventional study
